operation.name: $sql-run
operation.documentation: Execute a ViewDefinition, SQLQuery Library or SQLView Library and return the result in the requested output format. Supported output formats: csv, json, ndjson, fhir. Binary envelope representation is supported for csv, json and ndjson. The parquet and source parameters are not supported.

operation.name: $sql-export
operation.documentation: Export one or more ViewDefinitions, SQLQuery Libraries and SQLView Libraries as a single asynchronous job. Supported output formats: csv, json, ndjson. The parquet and source parameters are not supported.
